candidates.summary: Kick-start your engineering career with a paid cadetship combining hands-on experience, study support and diverse projects.
candidates.opening:
About the role
 Kick-start your engineering career with one of our exciting Cadet Civil Engineer opportunities. These fixed-term positions, for up to eight years, combine paid on-the-job experience with part-time study, supporting you to become a qualified professional engineer.
 Based in Moruya, you'll gain exposure across the four divisions of Council's Infrastructure Services Directorate, contributing to a variety of infrastructure projects that make a real difference to our community.
 As a Cadet Civil Engineer, you will:
 - Provide administrative and technical support across infrastructure operations, maintenance and construction activities.
 - Assist with investigations, concept designs and environmental assessments for infrastructure projects.
 - Liaise with Council staff, contractors, consultants and the community on engineering standards and requirements.
 - Prepare cost estimat
key_lines: Kick-start your engineering career with one of our exciting Cadet Civil Engineer opportunities. These fixed-term positions, for up to eight years, combine paid on-the-job experience with part-time study, supporting you to become a qualified professional engineer.
As a Cadet Civil Engineer, you will:
- Liaise with Council staff, contractors, consultants and the community on engineering standards and requirements.

The salary range for this position is $2,367.24 to $3,713.09 per fortnight, plus 12% superannuation. Commencing salary and progression through these grades will be determined by the level of; study completed; on the job experience and; responsibility required for the work undertaken.

If you're a motivated and forward-thinking individual who is keen to build a career in civil engineering and make a positive impact across the Eurobodalla region, we would love to hear from you! Whether you're about to commence or are already undertaking a Bachelor of Engineering, this cadetship provides a unique opportunity to combine paid employment with tertiary study and professional development.

- Generous leave provisions including Long Service Leave after 5 years of continuous service, study leave, 4 weeks annual leave, 2 weeks sick leave and 1 week "My Leave" annually (pro-rated for part-time or fixed term staff members).

Eurobodalla Shire Council follows a merit based recruitment and selection process. For help and guidance on how to apply for jobs at Council, please visit our website www.esc.nsw.gov.au or The Job Shop.
To apply for this position, you will need to:
- Provide your resume detailing your previous work experience
- Provide your cover letter highlighting your skills and experience (OPTIONAL)
- If you have completed schooling within the last five years, upload your most recent school report

Applicants who are currently completing their HSC are encouraged to apply. Applications must be supported by Year 11 and Year 12 results available at the time of submission, including indicative ATAR outcomes or early entry assessment results. Any offer of employment will be subject to the applicant meeting the relevant university entry requirements and providing evidence of enrolment in an approved course.
Applications close: Sunday 8 November 2026 at 11:00pm.

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to provide contact details for two referees. These will be collected at the interview stage. If you are a recent school leaver (having left school within the last two years), at least one referee should be a teacher, school mentor or other educational representative familiar with your performance and potential. Other referees may include current or former supervisors, employers, sporting coaches, volunteer coordinators or other individuals who can comment on your suitability for the position.

key_lines: Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Draftsperson/ BIM Modeler to join our design team and support the delivery of telecommunications infrastructure projects from concept through to construction and commissioning.

As a Draftsperson/ BIM Modeler, you will be responsible for developing and managing detailed 3D BIM models and drawings for telecommunications projects. You will work closely with RF Engineers, Design Engineers, Construction Teams, Project Managers, and clients to produce high-quality coordinated designs and project documentation.
- Develop and maintain BIM models for telecommunications infrastructure projects using Autodesk Revit.
- Incorporate laser scan and point cloud data into BIM models where required.
Essential Skills & Experience
- Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Drafting, Building Design, Architecture, or related discipline.
- Minimum 2 years' experience as a BIM Modeler, Revit Technician, CAD Designer, or similar role.
- Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit.
- Strong AutoCAD skills.
- Experience producing detailed engineering or infrastructure drawings.
- Telecommunications industry experience.
- Experience working on rail, tunnel, transport, airport, or infrastructure projects.
- Civil 3D
- Experience with point cloud modelling and reality capture workflows.
